description: Ministry of City Planning & Water Supply - Order to acquire the lands in Horana, Millaniya, Bandaragama and Minuwangoda D/S Divisions for Water Supply Projects
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It contains multiple orders under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act approving the acquisition of specific land parcels for water supply infrastructure projects. The content includes detailed descriptions of land boundaries, locations, extents, and claimant information, which falls squarely under the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters. While it mentions a minister's name and title, this is incidental to the core land acquisition content, and there are no detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes that would trigger a government-related classification.
